what_happened: Defect 2's dispatch-text headline ('vacuous pass on a parenthesised Goals header') is not reproducible: mechanical reproduction against lean-challenge-snapshot.sh shows the parenthetical-header bug produces a loud exit 71 ('no identifiers found'), not a silent pass, because the non-empty GOALS_FILE guard runs unconditionally before cross-validation on both R1 and R2 routes. The underlying START_RE anchor bug is still real and was verified fixable by widening the regex to drop the trailing-colon requirement.

Defect 5's evidence addendum (point 2) claims extensions/lean/manifest.json carries a null-valued routing_hard key. jq has() and a direct python3 key listing on both the source-store and deployed copies show no such key exists at all; git history shows it was fully removed from every manifest by commit ba2536209 (2026-10-02), well before this task was authored. The addendum's 'free partial fix' does not apply; gate16 trips on routing_agents_hard alone. Likely cause of the stale claim: jq's object-constructor syntax ({routing_hard, ...}) renders an ABSENT key as null in its output, visually indistinguishable from a genuinely-declared null value unless has() is used instead.

Defect 4 (literature-search.sh --read path resolution) and Defect 2's fix hypothesis were both confirmed by direct mechanical reproduction (unpatched failure, then patched scratch-copy success) rather than by inspection alone, closing out two of the five defects with measured evidence ahead of the plan/implement phases.
